SELECT O.owner_id, store_mainimage, store_name, owner_email, category_name, store_avgstar, owner_tel, store_tel, store_address, store_intro, store_status, store_reject_reason FROM owner O JOIN store S ON O.owner_id = S.owner_id JOIN category C ON S.category_id = C.category_id
O.owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner O JOIN store S ON O.owner_id = S.owner_id JOIN category C ON S.category_id = C.category_id
store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users U JOIN department D ON U.department_id = D.department_id
users_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board B JOIN users U ON B.users_id = U.users_id
users_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review R JOIN users U ON R.users_id = U.users_id JOIN store S ON R.store_id = S.store_id
review_status = 'Y'
AND review_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT R.review_id, U.users_id, S.store_id, R.review_star, R.review_content, R.review_date FROM review R JOIN users U ON R.users_id = U.users_id JOIN store S ON R.store_id = S.store_id
review_status = 'Y'
AND review_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
ORDER BY R.review_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
